attribution_rule: Attribute usage to the nearest preceding turn_context.payload.model; missing model metadata becomes unknown.

budget.basis: known-priced reference USD converted at reserve FX

dedupe_rule: Deduplicate by thread_id + response_id; if either ID is missing, use a stable source-session and ordinal fallback so distinct calls remain distinct.
selection_rule: Include token_usage_record.payload.usage from the main session only for selected project-turn records; include selected child sessions/threads in full. Repeated project turns are aggregated idempotently.

snapshot.note: Observed usage snapshot only; status complete does not mean the session has no future charges.

stage_attribution.note: Agent-stage mapping assigns a reused child's full history to one stage; treat it as approximate/shared. The default P0 charge is conservative for main turns spanning P0 architecture and P1 work.

warnings: The final main-response usage may not be finalized; rerun after completion.
Reference estimates are not actual intranet bills.
Complete accounting describes the observed snapshot, not future charges.
Stage attribution is exact only for turn overrides; agent-stage and default phase mappings are approximate/shared and conservatively charged.
